$comment: The words two products say the SAME fact with — written once (spec/README.md « One fact, one wording »). An entry is a shared sentence: its English text (parameters as {name}), the key the SITE writes it under in website/lang/en.json (null when only the mod says it, and why), and the screen nodes of the mod that carry it. check-spec.py holds them: the site's English value is this text (`:name` read as `{name}`), each node of each screen says exactly this, and no other text of a screen document repeats an entry without being named here. The site's 19 other languages and the mod's own wording are not touched: this is the English source both read. Not in spec/screens/: that folder is the mod's screens, every .json in it is embedded and parsed as one.

edit.question.text: “{words}” is a new form of “{term}”. Apply to:
edit.question.note: The question a correction asks when changed words are no known writing of a term (LineEditing.Question). The mod's bind `question` is this text with the two names written in.

edit.all_texts_help.text: Add the words to the term as a new form, for every text that cites it.
edit.all_texts_help.why: the mod has a help bar, the site no tooltip on these buttons yet: it may take this sentence as theirs, not write another

edit.only_this_text_help.text: Keep the words in this text alone. The term keeps its forms.

placeholder.sequence_missing.text: {sequence} is missing or changed. Keep it exactly as in the source text.
placeholder.sequence_missing.carried_by: the mod's EditChecks, if it chooses to say a placeholder fault to a person as the site does (it shows Placeholders.Accepts' English errors, written for a model)

placeholder.count.carried_by: the mod's FailureWords (Failures tab), for a placeholder AND for a bracket of the whole text (AnswerFaultKind.Brackets, the bracket in quotes as the token): one fact, one sentence; through AnswerFaults.GameWords. The mod's EditChecks (ValidateEditedPlaceholders), for a placeholder AND for a tag a person's edit lacks (Markup.KeptByEdit: the tag as the source wrote it as the token, found and expected)

placeholder.invented.text: {token} is not in the source text
placeholder.invented.carried_by: the mod's FailureWords (Failures tab), for a placeholder AND for a tag the answer wrote (AnswerFaultKind.TagInvented, the tag as the token): one fact, one sentence; through AnswerFaults.GameWords. The mod's EditChecks, if it says a placeholder fault as the site does

connection.unreachable_title.why: the mod's own corner: the site does not talk to a translation server
connection.unreachable_title.carried_by: the mod's corner callout UnreachableBox (overlay.json, bound as unreachableTitle), when the connection itself failed (Connectivity.Classify other than NoAnswer); the cause under it is Connectivity.Explain

connection.silent_title.text: No answer from the translation server
connection.silent_title.why: same corner: a fact distinct from the unreachable one, since the server took the connection and did not answer in time
connection.silent_title.carried_by: the mod's corner callout UnreachableBox (overlay.json, bound as unreachableTitle), when Connectivity.Classify says NoAnswer; the cause under it is Connectivity.Explain(NoAnswer)

format.older_mods.text: This translation uses format {format}. An older UGT Mod cannot read it.
format.older_mods.why: the site shows the chip vN with its tip (« Translation file format N. ») and « Made for a newer UGT Mod » to the client that cannot read it; this sentence is for the person who TAKES such a file, about the others
format.older_mods.carried_by: the mod, said once when a person takes a translation past the format 1 (download, merge) or writes the first term in a file of the format 1: TranslationFormat.OlderModsCannotRead. The other direction is TranslationFormat.UpdateTheMod

answer.labels_lost.carried_by: the mod's FailureWords (Failures tab): AnswerFaultKind.Labels, the labels of the source joined by a comma and a space

answer.values_joined.carried_by: the mod's FailureWords (Failures tab): AnswerFaultKind.ValuesRunTogether. Reads like answer.tag_emptied: two neighbouring facts, one grammar

answer.tag_order.why: the site has no check of the markup of a line
answer.tag_order.carried_by: the mod's FailureWords (Failures tab): AnswerFaultKind.TagOutOfOrder, through AnswerFaults.GameWords (the game's own tags in place of the tokens); and the mod's EditChecks (ValidateEditedPlaceholders) for Markup.KeptByEdit, whose facts hold the game's own tags
